description.value: Red Beard Cafe is a hybrid pub, cafe, and restaurant on Tranquille Road in Kamloops that has been a local gathering spot since 2012, pouring from 18 rotating craft beer and cider taps alongside third-wave espresso and cocktails. The kitchen turns out brunch, lunch, and dinner all made from scratch, with a dog-friendly patio for those traveling with four-legged companions. The venue also operates an on-site cocktail speakeasy called Nigel's Cocktails, adding a distinctive evening dimension to what is otherwise a full-day food-and-drink destination.
